messages:
Maya R: Quick kickoff 1 — SI certification launch next month. Need: proctor handbook, NDA language for exam content, exam windows, and the marketplace announcement alignment. Who owns what?
Ethan V: I can own the proctor handbook + training checklist. Want a lightweight remote-proctoring flow (honor code + spot-checks) rather than heavy vendor tooling for v1.
Priya S: Legal needs a one-paragraph NDA addendum for exam materials and a permitted-usage clause for recordings (if any). Will produce draft by Thu.
Nina L: Marketplace ask: certification badge visibility on partner listings and an API flag `certified:true`. Need the approval criteria and badge artwork before publishing.
Kai H: Solutions will supply two canonical hands-on tasks for the practical exam (marketplace deploy + cost-optimization mini-audit). I'll write brief rubrics.
Ethan V: Draft proctor checklist (initial):
```
- Verify participant identity (name + company email)
- Confirm signed NDA/consent
- Screen-share canonical lab for 10 min
- Run smoke test: `./verify_env.sh` (exit 0)
- Observe one scoring task for 15 min
- Record pass/fail + notes
```
Maya R: Nice. Priya, can NDA be one-click in the portal? We want low friction.
Priya S: Yes, e-sign consent via partner portal is fine. I'll add text and a checkbox flow, no uploads. Include retention period (90 days) and requester contact.
Nina L: For badges: we'll need the cert slug and a short description (<=140 chars). Also want a copy for the marketplace release notes: "SI-verified for Redwood inference deployments" or similar.
Kai H: Rubric highlights: 50% practical tasks, 30% troubleshooting & rationale, 20% configuration & cost decisions. Pass threshold 70%.
CertBot: cert-bot: provisional badge slug `redwood-si-certified-v1` created (internal only).
Ethan V: Trainers: propose two live proctor windows per week for 4 weeks + one weekend slot. Are those enough for global partners?
Maya R: We should add one APAC-friendly slot. So Mon 16:00 PT (Tue 09:00 AEST) and Thu 09:00 PT (Thu 18:00 CEST) plus Sat 11:00 PT. That covers majority.
Priya S: Also confirm whether partner trainees can record sessions. My recommendation: no recordings except proctor notes; keep minimal PII.
Nina L: Announcement plan: coordinate marketplace release the week after the first certified cohort. Need final list of certified SIs and badge assets by release day.
Kai H: Ops note: make sure lab images used in exam are immutable and versioned. Use tag `cert-v1.0` so results are reproducible.
Ethan V: I'll draft the proctor handbook + quick playbook for scoring and DM it here by Wed EOD. Can everyone review by Thu?
Maya R: Agree. Owners recap:
- Proctor handbook + schedule: Ethan
- NDA + consent flow: Priya
- Practical tasks + rubric: Kai
- Badge + marketplace release: Nina
- Logistics + partner comms: Maya
CertBot: cert-bot: scheduled reminder for reviewers 2026-05-01T09:00:00Z.
Maya R: Great work. Final ask: keep the exam window booking link in the doc and add a short FAQ for partners about appeals and re-tests. Locking this thread; will follow up with the runbook link. :rocket:
